## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Restore video titles and thumbnails in Android media controls during normal playback. ([#28](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/28))
- Apply the selected theme to the empty saved-NG message and its background. ([#27](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/27))
- Use subdued dark backgrounds for NG registration and deletion, with smaller delete buttons.
- Restore single-tap expansion for truncated comments and reserve NG actions for long presses. ([#31](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/31))
- Recognize rapid double taps without opening NG settings. ([#31](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/31))
- Ask for confirmation before deleting a saved NG setting.

- Center comment text vertically within each row.
- Keep auto-follow and sort controls visible while scrolling, and retain auto-follow until the user disables it. ([#34](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/34))
- Follow the last comment at or before the playback position and place it at the bottom of the list, without filtering future comments. ([#36](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/36))
- Use theme-aware input backgrounds and align input text with the surrounding dialog content. ([#27](https://github.com/chikuwadon/nicoid-re-patches/issues/27))

## 🔧 Improvements

- Add a search-suggestions toggle below the startup-screen setting.
- Move tap behavior below link behavior in General and remove the empty Video list category.
- Shorten the cast comment-reduction description.
- Save debug logs directly to Downloads as `nicoid-re_log_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss.txt`.
